tools.name: get_gita_verse
tools.description: Use when the user names a specific verse or range, e.g. 'Gita 2.47' or 'chapter 18 verses 65-66'. Returns the exact verse(s) with Sanskrit, IAST transliteration and two translations.

tools.name: get_gita_chapter_summary
tools.description: Use when the user asks what a chapter of the Bhagavad Gita is about, or wants an overview of the Gita's 18 chapters (pass chapter 0 for the list of all chapters).

tools.description: Use when the user asks for today's verse, a daily verse, or a random verse from the Bhagavad Gita. Same verse for everyone on a given day (India time).
